name: BryweLudramon
main_effect:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your effects places a digivolution card under this Digimon, your opponent's effects can't delete this Digimon or return it to its owner's hand or deck until the end of your opponent's turn.
[When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 Digimon card with the [Legend-Arms] trait and a play cost of 7 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon is [RagnaLoardmon], it isn't affected by the effects of your opponent's Digimon.
